input: scheduled: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products (ventures brief)
errors: A temporary check script first pointed its reference-scene cache inside the repo tree (tools/truths); killed within seconds and removed before any commit.
integrity_issues: Bayer's luma ramp was picked with a second rule added after seeing held-out results; disclosed in the eval note, README and post. X-Trans's pick is the same under both rules.

doc_friction.issue: The pyenv.py helper was not needed: a scratchpad venv with numpy/rawpy installed in under 2 minutes; photo-editing tests need PYTHONPATH=src, which a bare pytest run does not set (first full run errored on import).
photo-editing buildable item pointed at tools/noise_aware_planes.py rows, which carry no ramp grid; refitting needed a new sweep (~75 min, mostly LibRaw decoding reference scenes).

notes: Flagship 7 (photo-editing) BUILDABLE item: refit noise-aware ramps on luma. Shipped a split blend (luma from LUMA_RAMPS, colour difference from RAMPS). Held: Bayer luma +0.76->+0.99 dB, X-Trans +1.12->+1.28 dB over directional; RGB +0.35->+0.48, +0.51->+0.61; no tile worse than directional by over 0.08 dB. Restoring sensel raw values measured and rejected. Local: photo-editing suite 1268 passed, 10 skipped (PYTHONPATH=src, Python 3.11, numpy, rawpy 0.28).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an imaging engineer designing the sweep, running it, analysing the grid and shipping the split blend with tests and write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
